Label: Administrative Region
Description: Administrative regions as defined by the Global Administrative Area Database (GADM). The country node (administrativeRegion.USA) has this type only, with no level class.

Label: Administrative Region Level 0
Description: GADM level 0 administrative regions which represent countries. Declared in the schema but not populated in the current release.

Label: Administrative Region Level 1
Description: GADM level 1 administrative regions which are the highest level of division of a country, such as US states, Canadian provinces, or French departments. Each of the 51 states appears twice, as a KnowWhereGraph IRI and as a Data Commons geoId IRI linked by owl:sameAs, and both carry the same data (102 nodes).

Label: Administrative Region Level 2
Description: GADM level 2 administrative regions which further subdivide states, provinces, or departments. Examples include counties in the US. Each of the 3,114 counties appears twice, as a KnowWhereGraph IRI and as a Data Commons geoId IRI linked by owl:sameAs, and both carry the same data (6,228 nodes).

Label: Administrative Region Level 3
Description: GADM level 3 administrative regions. In the US, these are subdivisions of counties, formally known as county subdivisions, such as minor civil divisions (e.g. towns or townships) or census county divisions. These 35,458 regions are identified only by Data Commons geoId IRIs.

Label: S2 Cell
Description: A cell from the S2 discrete global grid system, which hierarchically subdivides the sphere.

Label: S2 Cell Level 10
